title: Could my game be as fun to others as it is to me?
author: Obewon9449
selftext:
This is definitely not a game trailer & there is still a tremendous amount of work to do but I'm genuinely curious if others would enjoy a game like this.. 

It's a horde style 'survive the wave' game where the main focus revolves around loot & character building. Your player has their main level with stats, gear, runes (and runewords), gems, etc. that help to increase their damage & survivability. Then there's the gameplay levels where you always start back at level 1 & each level you get "in game" gives you three options on abilities to improve (they always reset when starting a new game). The goal is to get better loot to better your character to take on harder levels. Think of Diablo 2 crosses with Vampire Survivors. 

Feel free to criticize but I only have around 10 hours with working with Claude on this. Also, Claude made all of the sprites & I will be changing them out later on.. & yes, I know there is no sound yet & the video got wonky towards the end with the side scroller but like I said, it isn't a trailer lol. 

Anyway, I've been having a blast playing this & I'd like to know what others would think as I know I'm a bit biased!
